newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down, but off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down, but off early lows.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Wednesday, but off early lows as select blue chips rose on fresh buying while but overall sentiment remained weak before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget due on June 13, dealers said.
"A rise in select blue chips helped the index to regain some of its lost ground," dealer Sajjad Mankani at Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said. "We can see a small pre-budget rally from these levels."
The KSE 100-share index fell 17.99 points, or 1.12 percent, to end at 1,587.94. Losers led gainers 201 to 73. Hub Power fell 1.0 to 40.30 rupees. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
